name: Any Post Import Export with ACF
author: iflairwebtechnologies

sections.description:
The Any Post Import Export with ACF plugin by iFlair is a powerful content migration tool between WordPress websites, simplifying the process of content migration. It allows easy import and export of posts with their content, along with ACF data, and featured images. In the case of default posts or custom post types, this plugin will ensure data transfer without any manual effort.

With its friendly interface, the plugin integrates very well with your WordPress dashboard, so it is easy to use for all skill levels.

Features

Single Post Import and Export:
Easily transfer individual posts from one WordPress site to another.

ACF Custom Fields Support:
Fully integrates with Advanced Custom Fields so that custom field data is also migrated.

Featured Image Migration:
Automatically includes featured images when transferring posts.

Seamless integration with WordPress:
Import and export options are available right from the default WordPress post editor, making it easy to access.

Simple and intuitive interface:
The plugin is designed to be user-friendly, requiring minimal setup and offering a smooth experience for users of all skill levels.

Supports all post metadata:
Migrates all essential post metadata so that nothing of your post details is lost during the transfer process.

Backup and Restore Feature:
This feature allows users to back up their posts before exporting, providing an added layer of security and reliability.

No Data Loss:
All post-related data, including ACF fields, custom taxonomies, and featured images, is preserved when importing or exporting posts.

Efficient Migration:
The plugin ensures fast and reliable post transfers, saving you time and effort during content migration.
sections.installation:
1. Go to your WordPress dashboard and navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for “Any Post Import Export with ACF”
  3. Install and activate the plugin.
  4. Once activated, the import and export options will appear in the post & page editor for default posts and pages.
sections.faq:
Can this plugin transfer posts between different WordPress themes?

Yes, the plugin works completely independently of your theme, meaning you can transfer posts, regardless of the theme being used on either site.

Does this plugin support bulk post transfers?

The current design of the plugin supports single post transfers, hence allowing for a precise transfer of content, ACF fields, and featured images.

Is this compatible with older versions of WordPress?

The plugin requires at least WordPress version 4.7. It has been tested up to version 6.7 for compatibility.

What happens if the destination site doesn’t have the same ACF fields?

If the destination site doesn’t have the same ACF fields, you may need to recreate them manually to display the data properly. The plugin will still transfer the field data.

Does this plugin support multisite WordPress setups?

Yes, it could be used in WordPress multisite installations to move posts across sites.
